died.name: Julius Caesar
died.cause: discovering that his stepson Brutus was among his murderers

died.name: Salvator Rosa
died.last_words: Bad, bad! To judge by what I now endure, the hand of death grasps me sharply.

died.name: Burton Abbott
died.cause: to prison physician Dr. David Schmidt prior to execution by gas chamber
died.last_words: I can't admit it, Doc. Think of what that would do to my mother. She could not take it.

died.name: Victor Feguer
died.cause: requesting his last meal prior to execution by hanging

died.name: Ruppert L. Sargent
died.desc: United States Army officer and Medal of Honor recipient
died.cause: prior to falling on two grenades during the Vietnam War

died.name: Timothy Gribble
died.last_words: I just want you to know from the bottom of my heart that I am truly sorry. I mean it. I'm not saying it.

born.name: Andrew Jackson
born.last_words: What is the matter with my dear children? Have I alarmed you? Oh, do not cry. Be good children and we will all meet in Heaven.

born.name: Jean Brillant
born.cause: fatally wounded by enemy machine-gun fire during World War I
born.last_words: I am through. Take charge of the company. I won't be here long.
